This app provides an etymological dictionary of Italian. 

With more than 49600 entries, this dictionary is one of the most comprehensive etymological dictionary of Italian for English speakers.

The app is useful resource for Italian teachers, students and anyone who is interested in the development of Italian language.

● Italian Etymology
- Detailed etymology and origin 
- Pronunciation 
- Detailed meaning 
- Cross reference 

● Parts of Speech
- Italian adjectives, adverbs, conjunctions, determiners, interjections, nouns, prepositions, pronouns, verbs

● Italian names
- Origin of Italian given names 
- Origin of Italian surnames

● Features
- Search for an entry, voice search
